profile.headline: Software Engineer - Gemini Enterprise
profile.summary:
I am currently a Staff Software Engineer at Databricks (https://databricks.com/) with multi-year, working experience with React, Angular, and TypeScript.  I enjoy writing clean, efficient solutions to complex problems.

Front-End: JavaScript, React, AngularJS, Angular, and TypeScript
Back-End: .NET and .NET Core, Python / Django, Node.JS, MSSQL, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead for the Content Platform File-browsing team. Focused on user-focused experiences for organizing, managing, sharing, and permissioning of content throughout the Databricks ecosystem of products.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Garden Design System
positions.description: Create tooling, component libraries, and front-end best practices for the Garden Design System for use by engineers and teams within all Zendesk products, Zendesk App Framework, and 3rd party developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Develop web and .net applications to help automate accounting, production, and web-based marketplaces.

positions.title: Intern - Aviation Tooling
positions.description: Develop web-based code analysis tools centered around aviation and safety.  Develop Connect IQ applications for low-power fitness wearables.

positions.title: Webmaster and Sysadmin
positions.description: Develop web applications, recruitment strategies, and maintain existing resources of the Computing and Information Sciences Department at Kansas State University.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Design and develop large-scale, real-time web applications for fitness and business applications.

honors.title: Hack K-State 2016 Hackathon Winner
honors.description:
Won first place and were picked as a 'Staff Favorite' by DevPost.com

Created system to support text messaging with personal contacts on Amazon Echo devices.  Used node.js, AWS Lambda, AWS Skills Kit, Digital Ocean, and the Ionic Framework to create applications.

Web-service: https://github.com/austin94/TextAlexa
Mobile Applications: https://github.com/austin94/TextAlexa-Mobile
honors.issuer: Issued by Kansas State University · May 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Founded in 2011, Black Girls CODE (BGC) was built on the pillars of empowerment and education and is dedicated to leveling the playing field for girls of color in STEM. Through the organization's tech education-focused programming and initiatives-designed for young women between the ages of 7 to 17-BGC aims to inspire youth to become innovators in STEM fields, leaders in their communities, and builders of their own futures.
